verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as an AI coding agent. Its GitHub integration explicitly lets you "ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature," after which it works in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes. The docs contrast this with a read-only plan agent, implying the default agent edits code, and community users describe it as their primary coding harness. Some users report unreliable file edits and failed tool calls, mainly with local models, which lowers confidence but does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of multi-file editing in the local build agent; independent hands-on evidence of successful cross-file feature or bug implementations; reliability across models (edits fail with some local models).
